ITEM 1 | Cluster of sliced red fruit wedges, bright red with slightly glossy, moist surfaces, some pale white core edges and a few small seeds, lying in a fanned group about 7 x 9 cm on the left of the plate, roughly 2 cm thick, holding their shape with a little juice pooled beneath | 90
ITEM 2 | Single red wedge, bright red and moist with a pale center, about 5 x 6 cm and 1.5 cm thick, sitting next to the dark leaves at the center-top of the plate | 30
ITEM 3 | Large dark green leaves, crumpled and glossy with visible pale veins and stems, covering about 14 x 12 cm at the upper right of the plate, thin and layered | 60
ITEM 4 | Lower dark green leaves, crumpled and slightly wilted with pale midribs and a thick pale stem at the bottom, spanning about 9 x 10 cm on the right side below the upper leaves | 35
ITEM 5 | Thin shreds of orange carrot, bright orange, stringy and slightly crisp, scattered across the lower leaves and near the red slices | 3
ITEM 6 | Pinkish-red watery juice smears on the white plate surface beside the red slices, thin and translucent | 3
ITEM 7 | Small pale yellow-white bits, crumbly and soft, a few millimeters across, scattered near the upper edge of the lower leaves | 2
